Embrace the poetic charm of the ocean with these natural pearl and seashell earrings, where elegance meets nature. -Style: Coastal / Bohemian / Minimal French

Care Instructions
-Do not wear earrings while bathing or swimming to extend their lifespan
-It is recommended to store them separately to avoid scratches
